name: app
description: Fabric Weave: a Rayfin app that scores Power BI semantic models for AI-readiness and proposes reviewable fixes.
author: Fabric Weave contributors

template.name: universal-app
template.description: A lean React + Vite starter that grows into anything. A built-in capability router reads what you ask for, then enables the right Rayfin services, installs the right modules, and activates the right skills — CRUD apps, functions, charts, or Fabric analytics dashboards.

scripts.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/engine build && node scripts/validate-functions.mjs && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
scripts.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/engine build && node scripts/validate-functions.mjs && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/engine build && node scripts/validate-functions.mjs && npm run -w @rayfin-app/functions build && tsc -b
scripts.validate:functions: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/engine build && node scripts/validate-functions.mjs

rayfinScriptBases.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
rayfinScriptBases.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
